card.title: GUADALCANAL
card.text: Guadalcanal is an island in the Solomon Islands, captured by the US in 1943.
card.flavorText: Guadalcanal is an island in the Solomon Islands where a military campaign in WWII was fought between Japan and the United States. The Guadalcanal Campaign lasted from August 7, 1942 to February 9, 1943, and was the first Allied major land offensive against Japan and the first decisive victory won by the Allies in the Pacific.  What made the island a strategic place of importance was the Henderson Field air base which helped the Allies to control the sea lines of communications between Australia and the United States.
